Who We Are
Fogarty Finger (FF) is an interdisciplinary design studio of over 145 architects and designers dedicated to placemaking within the urban built environment. Founded in 2003, FF is responsible for many prominent residential and commercial projects throughout the United States, with offices in New York, Atlanta, and Boston.
We believe beautiful spaces build great experiences. Our projects are equally evocative and pragmatic - designed to be enjoyed by everyone. We design for the long term and create thoughtful buildings and interiors with timeless appeal.
About the Role
FF is seeking a talented Junior Designer to join our Groundup studios in New York. We are looking for candidates with strong design skills and 3D modeling abilities for in-house design development use, client presentation, and competition across a wide range of project typologies. The right candidate possesses a good design sensibility, an eye for detail, and the ability to communicate visually. Working under the guidance of senior staff, you will contribute to projects across all phases – from early design exploration through construction documentation – building your technical foundation in a collaborative, design-forward studio environment.
What You’ll Do
What You Bring
Why Join FF?
Fogarty Finger has never stopped growing — and neither will you. Since our founding, we've expanded steadily across New York, Atlanta, and Boston, taking on a remarkable breadth of project types along the way. As a mid-sized firm, we blend the best aspects of large and small firm culture. Joining our New York office means genuine exposure to the full arc of design, from early concept through construction administration, across residential, commercial, workplace, and hospitality work. You won't be pigeonholed into a single phase or project type — you'll be in the room for all of it.
